This is detectable from the labels alone. The drawn geometry is 0.30 + 5.80 + 0.115 + 3.485 + 0.30 = 10.00 m, so the chain labels, not the geometry, are at fault.
The drawn room is 5.800 m x 6.400 m clear (x 121.89-286.30 pt, y 433.70-615.12 pt), giving 37.12 m2. The printed 31.2 m2 is 5.9 m2 too small.
The drawn room is 3.485 m x 4.085 m clear (x 289.56-388.35 pt, y 433.70-549.50 pt), giving 14.24 m2. The printed 13.4 m2 is 0.84 m2 too small.

The drawn room is 3.485 m x 2.200 m clear (x 289.56-388.35 pt, y 552.76-615.12 pt), giving 7.67 m2. The printed 6.9 m2 is 0.77 m2 too small. Note the three area labels also sum to 51.5 m2 against 59.0 m2 of net floor area actually enclosed, and no consistent rectangular layout inside the 9.40 x 6.40 m envelope can produce the three printed figures simultaneously.

findings.kind: door swing does not match its wall opening
findings.element: Door between WOHNEN and SCHLAFEN, in the vertical 11.5 cm partition
findings.explanation: The wall opening is the white gap from y=504.57 to y=532.91 pt (1.00 m). The door leaf and swing arc are drawn hinged at (289.56, 504.57) with the closed-leaf position running upwards to y=476.22 pt, i.e. the swing is mirrored and lies entirely over solid wall, 1.00 m above the actual opening. As drawn the door cannot close into its frame.

findings.kind: circulation defect - bathroom only accessible through bedroom
findings.element: BAD (bathroom) - only door is in the horizontal partition between BAD and SCHLAFEN
findings.explanation: BAD has exactly one opening (x 295.23-320.74 pt in the horizontal partition at y=549.5 pt), which leads into SCHLAFEN. There is no door from WOHNEN to BAD, so the only route to the bathroom is through the bedroom. Flag for the designer before this goes to the contractor - it is usually unintended in a flat of this layout.

structured_output.summary: The drawn geometry is internally consistent (10.00 x 7.00 m envelope, 30 cm exterior walls, 11.5 cm partitions, all correct at 1:100), but the annotation on top of it is not. Two chain dimensions are wrong (5.86 should be 5.80, 4.00 should be 3.485), so the chain sums to 10.575 m against the printed overall of 10.00 m, and all three room areas are understated (WOHNEN 31.2 vs 37.12, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs 14.24, BAD 6.9 vs 7.67 m2). In the drawing itself, the WOHNEN/SCHLAFEN door swing is mirrored and sits 1.00 m above its wall opening, and the bathroom is only reachable through the bedroom - please confirm both before issue.
